description: Get the full record of one dental clinic in Norway, a dentist (tannlege) or specialist practice, by organisation number (org_nr) or id. Returns name, address, phone, mobile, e-mail, website, online booking link, Helfo status, emergency duty when it has a recorded source, specialties, chain, specialists, treatments, opening hours, payment options, the clinic's own description and profile URL.
name: tannlege_info
title: Get full details for a dental clinic
